WildJailbreak

dataset.wildjailbreak

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Creator-maintained documentation received separate bounded AI source-content review of identity, construction, human/model roles, formats, access/rights statements and limitations. New human labels or generated rationales/traces are distinguished from inherited inputs. Release configurations, mirrors, source seeds and model names do not multiply family coverage. Actual full/partial/unread source scopes remain in the review records; no corpus download, recount, exhaustive rights clearance, operational audit or model reproduction is represented.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WildJailbreak documentation-bound manifestation @ 5ddc12a7894f842b · generated: WildJailbreak transforms vanilla harmful prompts with 2–7 mined tactics using Mixtral-8×7B/GPT-4, filters low-risk/off-topic results and reuses counterpart vanilla refusals.

cohort5.dataset.claim.wildjailbreak.adversarial-origin

  • Creator documentation statement at the captured version; documentation pin does not prove corpus-byte identity. New adversarial prompts can share target responses with vanilla rows; no disjoint-pair assertion.
  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate; no independent source-verifier or adversarial review, publication approval, or authoritative depth/core promotion is represented.
